title: Arnab: heavy rain Wed–Thu in Khammam, Mulugu, Kothagudem, Mahabubabad
body: IMD Hyderabad has an orange alert for heavy to very heavy rain in four eastern districts on Wed and Thu as Cyclone Arnab crosses the Andhra coast. Winds of 50–60 kmph are likely across eight districts.
means: Push road trips to Khammam or Bhadrachalam on Oct 28–29
Hyderabad: no alert, light to moderate rain till Nov 1
care: Travelling east on Oct 28–29? Postpone if you can.
